messages.subject: Error message when using ddf.gof

Any ideas?
Cheers,
Michele

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Error message when using ddf.gof
parts:
Mike

I can't duplicate your problem using package versions 1.0.1 for Distance  and 2.2.2 for mrds 

library(Distance)
data("capercaillie")
conversion.factor <- convert_units("meter", "kilometer", "hectare")
bins <- c(0, seq(from=7.5, to=67.5, by=10), 80)
bins
caper.hn.bin <- ds(data=capercaillie, key="hn", adjustment="cos", cutpoints=bins,
                   convert.units=conversion.factor)
caper.hn.bin$ddf$meta.data$binned
gof_ds(caper.hn.bin)

What am I not doing that you are doing?  Are we working with similar versions?

I don't spend much time using mrds these days, so I'm fuzzy on its workings.  But if you use ddf() for model fitting, rather than ds(), seems you ought to perform your goodness-of-fit testing with ddf.gof() rather than with gof_ds() 

See if that pairing makes things better.

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Error message when using ddf.gof

Mike

Working with binned data, you won't get a visualisation of fit from ddf.gof() as it will only create qq-plots, and those are only available with exact distance data.  You should get a visualisation from simply calling plot(gu.hn.null)
